arabic: إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَاماً فَلْيَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللهِ، فَإِنْ نَسِيَ فِي أَوَّلِهِ فَلْيَقُلْ: بِسْمِ اللهِ فِي أَوَّلِهِ وَآخِرِهِ.
transliteration: Bismillaah. (If you forget, then say): Bismillaahi fee awwalihi wa aakhirihi.
translation: When any of you eats, he should say: 'In the Name of Allah.' If he forgets in the beginning, he should say: 'In the Name of Allah in its beginning and its end.'

arabic: مَنْ أَطْعَمَهُ اللهُ الطَّعَامَ فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ. وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ اللهُ لَبَناً فَلْيَقُلْ: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ.
transliteration: Allahumma baarik lanaa feehi wa at'imnaa khayran minh. (For milk): Allahumma baarik lanaa feehi wa zidnaa minh.
translation: Whomever Allah feeds, should say: 'O Allah, bless it for us and feed us better than it.' And whomever Allah gives milk to drink, should say: 'O Allah, bless it for us and give us more of it.'
